recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-11122; future changes to Immunization.status should come from a new PHWG decision.
issue_request: FHIR-11122 was a Published FHIR-core Immunization change request, resolved Persuasive, reporting that GForge item 9070 had been voted on but had not made it into the STU3 version. Its Jira comment says the change was applied on 2016-11-04.
initial_application: Commit 1212b3f471b75003758b78b258e740eed23a98dd explicitly addressed tracker items 9070 and 11122, changed Immunization.status from the broader in-progress/on-hold/completed/entered-in-error/stopped list to completed/entered-in-error, moved the binding away from the MedicationAdministration status value set, and introduced an Immunization-specific status value set.
additional_context: FHIR-9070 is the underlying same-change-family issue. Later R4/R5/R6 work intentionally aligned Immunization with the Event workflow pattern by removing notGiven, adding status=not-done for not-administered/refused events, and refining statusReason/reason guidance. PHWG minutes, FHIR-14377, FHIR-54325, and FHIR-55330 support the current completed/entered-in-error/not-done model.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The active Immunization source still excludes the broad MedicationAdministration statuses that prompted the original issue, and the only additional status code, not-done, comes from later approved Immunization/Event-pattern work.
